disclaimer: Context + risk posture — an AI risk-officer reading of the engine's own deterministic outputs, not a forecast and not stock selection. The directive is a SIZING posture, clamped in code so it can only be more cautious than the engine, never less. Every claim cites the evidence it is based on; graded against the tape over time. Treat as odds.
risk_read: The engine's elevated (60/100) risk_state reasonably flags the tactical drawdown risk, but under-weights the breadth of the technical stress. [E3] shows 13 breakdowns versus only 2 rolling, with major index proxies (SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, TLT) and most sector ETFs (XLY, XLB, XLP, XLU, XLI, XLK) all breaking down simultaneously. Dealer gamma is firmly short with net GEX at -54.69bn and spot below flip, indicating a vol-hole EXPANSION regime where market makers amplify rather than dampen moves [E4]. Complacency is still on watch, not alarm, but credit is already widening [E2]. The key nuance: engine technical driver is maxed at 1.0, yet the aggregate score only sits at 60 because macro_risk is still low and dislocation is calm [E8], so the damaging path is a slow, grinding index rollover led by internals rather than a sudden macro shock. This argues the engine is roughly right on level but slightly under-stating the speed at which weak internals are converting into index-level stress.

directive.rationale: Drawdown risk is building via broad index technical stress plus short gamma and widening credit. The engine is not too quiet on level, so sizing cut should be measured rather than slashing. A subtract-only 25% gross cut with focus on the most crowded or technically broken exposures captures most of the avoidable de-gross risk without overreacting to a still-low macro/dislocation reading.

dissent: One could argue the engine is too loud (not too quiet) because prophet gate_go=False [E7], dislocation verdict=calm, and macro_risk=low [E8] suggest this is a slow, internal-rotational grind rather than an acute risk event. If macro remains calm and credit widening is contained, the current elevated score will overstate eventually realized drawdown depth. However, being early on de-gross while dealer gamma is short and 13 assets are already breaking down is materially cheaper than discovering a contagion chain after it has fully formed.
